meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能检索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库,回答你之前会话里做过的事。流程是搜索 → 时间线 → 取详情,产出带 ID 的结果表和摘要;只有在摘要不够时才调出原始工具输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问到之前会话(不是当前对话)里的事,例如“这个问题我们是不是解决过?”、“上次 X 是怎么做的?”等,就会触发检索。

say.text: 帮我搜一下之前会话里关于 authentication 的记录
say.note: 返回一张带 ID 的结果表

say.text: 这个 bug 我们之前是不是修过?查一下过去的会话
say.note: 先搜索引,再按需取详情

say.text: 把上次那个迁移失败的完整命令输出调出来
say.note: 摘要不够时才取原始工具输出

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory for work done in past sessions. It works search → timeline → fetch, returning ID'd result tables and summaries, and only pulls raw tool I/O when a summary is not enough.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions (not the current chat): “did we already solve this?”, “how did we do X last time?”, “what happened last week?” etc.

say_en.text: Search my memory for anything about authentication
Did we already fix this bug? Check past sessions
say_en.note: Searches the index first, then details

say_en.text: Show the exact command output from last week's migration
say_en.note: Fetches raw tool I/O only if needed
